text: Federal Reserve Board requests comment on a proposal to modernize its rule governing the extension of credit to bank "insiders"—bank executives, board members and major shareholders who could potentially influence a bank's lending decisions
text_zh: 美联储理事会就一项提案征求公众意见，该提案旨在现代化其对银行"内部人"——即可能影响银行贷款决策的高管、董事会成员及主要股东——信贷展期的规定
